### **Job Title**

Director, Quality Systems- Processes & Capabilities

### **Job Description**

Director, Quality Systems- Processes & Capabilities

The Director, Quality Systems- Processes & Capabilities is responsible for overseeing the strategic management of the QMS department, aligning it with organizational goals and industry best practices. The role formulates and implements QMS strategies to drive continuous improvement and ensures high standards of quality and compliance. The role oversees the analysis of complex QMS data and trends across multiple functions to identify systemic issues, leads cross-functional teams in root cause analysis, and drives the implementation of strategic quality improvement initiatives.

**Your role:**

* Oversees the strategic direction and management of the QMS department, aligning it with organizational goals, company policies, and industry best practices. Partners with senior leadership so that quality strategy supports operational efficiency, risk management, and business growth.
* Supports QMS functions such as document control, internal audits, CAPA, and training, ensuring effective implementation, compliance, and continuous improvement. Drives advanced training and competency programs, and keeps current on quality standards, to promote organization-wide adherence and continuous learning.
* Analyzes complex QMS data and trends across functions to identify systemic issues and leads cross-functional teams in root cause analysis and strategic quality improvement initiatives. Develops and maintains quality metrics and reports to track QMS performance and keep management informed.
* Leads quality risk management frameworks and advises executive leadership on regulatory changes, compliance risks, and quality trends. Represents the organization in industry forums, regulatory discussions, and quality committees to share best practices and help shape future standards.
Facilitates strategic cross-functional collaboration to resolve high-impact quality issues and align with organizational quality objectives. Owns planning, staffing, budgeting, and priorities, and leads succession planning and talent management, including selection, performance, compensation, and career development. 

 

**You're the right fit if:**

* You’ve acquired 15+ years of experience in Quality Management Systems, Quality Audits or equivalent in industry areas such as Medical Device, Pharmaceutical, or Biotech. 7+ years of people leadership experience managing teams of direct reports.
* Your skills include strategic Director-level leadership, independent decision-making, and the ability to lead experienced technical teams in a global, FDA-regulated environment. Your skills include enterprise QMS technology leadership, system validation, regulatory compliance, vendor management, and quality-system modernization across platforms such as Veeva, Windchill, and ARIS.
* You have a Bachelor’s/master’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer/Software Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.
* You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position .
You’re an independent, strategic leader who navigates ambiguity with confidence, makes sound decisions, and builds trust across experienced teams and global stakeholders. You must be willing and able to travel up to 10%. 

**How we work together**

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

This is an office-based role.

The pay range for this position in Murrysville, PA or Nashville, TN is $162,000 to $258,000.

The pay range for this position in Plymouth, MN is $170,000 to $270,000.

The pay range for this position in Cambridge, MA is $181,000 to $288,000.

The actual base pay offered may vary within the posted ranges depending on multiple factors including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.

In addition, other compensation, such as an annual incentive bonus, sales commission or long-term incentives may be offered. Employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive Philips Total Rewards benefits program, which includes a generous PTO, 401k (up to 7% match), HSA (with company contribution), stock purchase plan, education reimbursement and much more. Details about our benefits can be found here .

At Philips, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each case.

**Additional Information**

US work authorization is a precondition of employment. The company will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work-authorized visa, now or in the future.

Company relocation benefits **will not** be provided for this position. For this position, you must reside in **or** within commuting distance to posted locations **.**
